items.title: Victoria announces poultry lockdown as bird flu cases spread
items.description: Testing confirmed a further 20 cases of H5N1avian influenza in Victoria on Friday, all in greater crested terns along the state's south-west coast.

items.title: Five quick questions about Trump's birthright orders answered
items.description: US President Donald Trump is taking another swing at limiting birthright citizenship. Here are five simple questions to break down what's happened.

items.title: AI models design viruses not found in nature for first time
items.description: Researchers from Stanford University have synthesised brand-new, self-replicating viruses using genomes designed by artificial intelligence for the first time, raising the possibility of significant medical advancements but also prompting concerns the technology could be misused.

items.title: A 'gasp' and he was gone. Coroner warns of Federation Peak dangers
items.description: A Victorian bushwalker who wanted to climb Federation Peak in Tasmania's south-west as part of his "bucket list" had turned back with his companions when he fell, a coroner says.

items.title: Jury told to disregard seven sex assault charges against former Catholic bishop
items.description: The judge in the sexual abuse trial of the former Catholic Bishop of Broome has told the jury that he can not be found guilty of seven of the charges against him.

items.title: Fatalities confirmed after school shooting in Thailand
items.description: Seven people, including teachers and students, have died after a student opened fire at a school in Thailand.

items.title: Imam calls out pro-Palestine rally comments as 'inappropriate'
items.description: A prominent Australian imam has said comments made at a pro-Palestinian rally at which another imam described October 7, 2023 as a "day of pride" and "victory" were inappropriate.

items.title: Man says he was 'very scared' during alleged Alan Jones bedroom assault
items.description: A man accusing Alan Jones of historical indecent assault has told a court he followed the broadcaster's alleged direction to have a shower and come out in a robe because he did not want to disappoint Mr Jones.

items.title: The key takeaways from six days of evidence at NDIS Senate inquiry
items.description: A Senate inquiry into the proposed NDIS shake-up was told the government must stamp out rorting, while avoiding cuts that could put participants in unsafe environments and cause carers to burn out. Here are the key takeaways from the six days of hearings.

items.title: Woman found dead in suspected murder-suicide was pregnant, police confirm
items.description: A crime scene remains in place in Charleville after a suspected murder-suicide, with police confirming a 23-year-old woman found dead was pregnant.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
